ticket.title: Claim leases expire but nothing returns the task to the backlog, so the board shows ghost work
ticket.description:
Reported by the owner 2026-11-06: the workbench showed GB-195 and GB-236 as in progress when nobody was working on them, and no ticket ever appeared to transition while work was happening.

Two distinct causes. (1) MISSING REAPER: AgentClaim carries a TTL and is_expired exists, and claim_task already allows a takeover of an expired lease, but nothing moved an InProgress task back to Ready when its holder stopped heartbeating. GB-195 and GB-236 had been InProgress with leases expired 128 and 131 hours. (2) PROCESS: work was verified without ever being claimed, so tickets went Ready -> Verified with no InProgress in between and the board never showed the work.

Fix for (1): 'storypole reap' plus --dry-run releases the lease (TaskReleased) and returns the task to Ready (StatusChanged with the expiry in the reason). Explicit command rather than a read side effect, because a status change is a ledger event and a read-only checkout must not fail. Verified on this workspace: dry-run named exactly GB-195 and GB-236, the run returned both, and benchwork capabilities then matched storypole ledger-reconcile exactly - archived 61, blocked 4, deferred 26, ready 18, triage 12, verified 164, and no inprogress bucket.

OUTSTANDING: no unit test covers the reaper yet - it was verified against the live ledger only. The next change here should add a temp-store test asserting that an expired claim yields TaskReleased then StatusChanged and a live one yields nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Unit test in storypole-core/tests/archive_and_lease_tests.rs (storypole 1590f95): 4 tests covering archive state
expired-claim reaping and a live claim being left alone; workspace nextest 55/55.

verification_receipt.summary: Reaper shipped in storypole 542f960 ('storypole reap' + --dry-run). Measured: dry-run named exactly GB-195 and GB-236 (leases expired 128h and 131h), the run returned both to Ready, ledger-reconcile went from inprogress 2 / ready 16 / verified 163 to no inprogress / ready 18 / verified 164 with index and ledger agreeing, and the rebuilt benchwork capabilities then reported the identical set. Unit test for the reaper is still outstanding and recorded on the ticket.
